scale.3: correct and complete with minor weaknesses
scale.4: correct, complete, clear and well finished

rules: Judge only the supplied task, artifact and executable evidence.
For creative tasks inspect novelty, decisions, termination and the example; do not equate keyword coverage with quality.
For optimisation inspect legal algorithm, measured improvement and truthful iteration report; no invented timings.
For UI inspect supplied own-engine screenshots separately; a text judge cannot certify visual taste.
For maths check every displayed result and source faithfulness.
A missing artifact scores zero. State uncertainties; do not infer unseen behaviour.
Scores are uncalibrated model judgements, never human preference or proof of quality equivalence.
noninferiorityClaim: none; two repetitions and an uncalibrated judge cannot establish population quality equivalence
